newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The Romanian government is holding a working session.
* The State Ownership Fund (FPS) pledged to liquidate all state-owned companies which are an obstacle to privatisation and market liberalisation, FPS president Sorin Dimitriu told a conference.
* Dimitriu said the FPS and the transport ministry were preparing a set of tough measures to restructure the national airline Tarom. The plan is expected to be released in the coming weeks.
